desc: 嚼嚼松果把生日这天定为了“世界企鹅保护日”。也许世界上已经有这么一个保护日了，但管它呢，嚼嚼松果就是要这么做。|第一助手帮助绒毛公爵褪了毛，这减轻了嚼嚼松果对圣洛夫基金会职员的成见。于是在嚼嚼松果生日这天，十四行诗的房间门口出现了一块坚果蛋糕。|大多数动物的社会中都没有“生日”的概念，于是在皮克勒斯的帮助下，嚼嚼松果花了一整天起草了一份《动物神秘学家生日庆祝指南》。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪90年代，参展时长5年，诞生自5月20日春。展出于美利坚合众国佛罗里达州。

尺寸：47 15/64×17 23/32×7 7/8in.
介质：干松果
香调：馥奇调 橡木苔 快乐鼠尾草 杜松子
灵感：热烈的松实[木] 动物之友

character_data.title: 手作棉线徽章
character_data.text: 由企鹅“绒毛公爵”、“红色泰坦”、“杰克老弟”亲手缝纫的得意之作，是受访者的军功章。

character_data.title: “绝不迷失”
character_data.text:
古董质感的黄铜指南针。据说来自南方镖客酒馆的一场失火，彼时只有身材娇小灵活的啮齿目能够灵活跃入。
在这段漫长的故事讲述中，受访者着重渲染了自己的见义勇为，而遗忘了向我们解释自己是如何获得这枚古董指南针的。

character_data.title: “毛绒专用信号”
character_data.text:
我们偶尔也会意识到，一只会说话的松鼠纵然会讲话，可能也并没有掌握人类的文字拼读能力。
这似乎暗示着，在某种意义上传呼机的作用形同虚设。对此，受访者立刻表示否定，急切地解释自己会使用传呼机向企鹅队员发送队内的专用代码。

character_data.title: 赞美阳光！
character_data.text:
“我们的自由取决于新闻自由，新闻自由一旦受限，自由也将不复存在！”——托马斯·杰斐逊

有些地方习惯把数据藏得严严实实，感谢《第一修正案》，佛罗里达州政府在一个透明鱼缸里！每位居民都能把头伸进去看一眼，并且对鱼缸造景大肆评价。

年度教育预算、公共垃圾处理支出、每年被鳄鱼咬伤的人数、每年被人咬伤的鳄鱼数量……这可不是什么荒诞故事，这是发生在你我身边的现实情景剧！每个人都可以参演，但我们强烈建议在法律允许的范围中编写剧本，并避免非法闯入任何私人土地。
对，就算你是松鼠也不行！

character_data.title:
《迈阿密办事处关于
动物神秘学家的处置讨论》
character_data.titleEn:
Miami Branch: Meeting Minutes
on the Sheltering of Animal Arcanists
character_data.text:
“没人觉得这场会议的标题太长了吗？会议室门上的白板都快写不下了。”职员罗伯特如此感叹。

“别逃避工作了！再怎么喜欢小动物，你也不能把它偷偷藏起来！那可是个神秘学家，不是你从达德兰商场里买的发声婴儿玩具！”职员哈兰德深吸了一口气。

“而且那嗓音和婴儿玩具半个利齿子儿关系都没有，它听起来和咱们是一个年纪！”职员哈兰德进一步补充，声音提高。

“我得纠正你，哈兰德。它根本没有在说英语——在录入信息时，它的声音波形仍属于啮齿类动物叫声。”职员罗伯特纠正道。

“所以咱们要把它报告给总部调研中心吗？”职员哈兰德退一步提议。

“什么？当然不！你忍心把这么一个灵巧的小生灵变成咱们的样子吗？”职员罗伯特尖叫道。

“好吧，一个能与任何动物交流的神秘学家。我有个点子，拜托我们的人事部门发一份工作意向书，让它在迈阿密地区帮忙发掘其他的动物神秘学家。”职员哈兰德更退一步，向职员罗伯特妥协。

“不走总部流程？”职员罗伯特提出质疑。

“不走总部流程。”职员哈兰德笃定道。
“只是为了给它找点事做，好让它别再去动物园捣乱，动物园经理已经为此在我们门口坐了三天了。”

character_data.title: “正式”员工
character_data.text:
白雪松：你是什么时候意识到自己是神秘学家的？
嚼嚼松果：让我想想……好吧，是在代表树洞里的兄弟姐妹们与啄木鸟谈判的时候。
白雪松：啄木鸟告诉了你，你是一名神秘学家？
嚼嚼松果：什么？当然不！他们只是一个饿坏了的小家庭，管理处喷了太多杀虫剂，整整七天，他们连一只蚜虫都没找到！
白雪松：关于公园管理处滥用杀虫剂的控诉已经登上过迈阿密当地报纸了。
嚼嚼松果：是的！感谢基金会的那个哥们！他非常热情，主动帮我把投诉信送到了报社——他甚至愿意给我提供一份工作！
白雪松：工作？
嚼嚼松果：没错，基金会的工作！就是他告诉了我“神秘学家”是个什么玩意儿。
嚼嚼松果：那老哥看起来累得快要死掉了，但他对动物很友好，希望我真的能帮上他的忙。
白雪松：我明白了……顺便一提，我能看一眼你的基金会职员证吗？
嚼嚼松果：职员证？

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 新的冰原，新的大树！这儿真是个好地方，伙计。#0|基金会的小气鬼们怎么不早把你介绍给我呢？#4|难道你们真信了报纸上的鬼话？#7.5|我想想……《迈阿密惊现动物越狱事件，幕后黑手竟是松鼠？》！#10
character_voice.encontent: A brand new home, and a whole new world to discover! #0|What took the Foundation so dang long to introduce me to ya? #4.4|Don't tell me they really believe that hooey in the papers? #7.7|What'd it say again? ... "Miami Animal Jailbreak Perpetrated by Squirrel"?#11.2

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 看呐，又一场“好雨”！#0|泡烂我所有珍藏的干果，让我不得不每三天就修一次尾巴里的松针！#1.8|拜托，请告诉我，你这豪华树洞里的雨季不会像迈阿密的那么长！#6.5
character_voice.encontent: It's comin' up a toad strangler now, ain't it? #0|Darn rain, soaked my nut collection, sendin' the pine needles all a'growin' in my tail—I trimmed 'em twice this week already! #2.9|Please, tell me the rainy season 'round here ain't as long as the one in Miami!#11.6

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 基金会的兽医告诉我，松鼠只能活十年——#0|彻、彻头彻尾的危言耸听！#3.1|我知道华盛顿动物园里有松鼠过了十二岁生日！#5.7
character_voice.encontent: The Foundation vet had the cheek to say that squirrels only live for ten years ... #0|Hah! Fella must be losin' his marbles! #4.4|I'll have ya know, a pal o' mine up at the National Zoo just had his twelfth birthday!#8.1

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: ……#0|你可以维持面无表情，伙计，但你的眼睛说出了一切：“哇哦，会说话的松鼠！”#11.5
character_voice.encontent: ... #0|I see through that poker face o' yers. Yer mouth may not be movin', but yer eyes're sayin' "Wow, a talkin' squirrel!"#11.5

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 好人路过树下，能得到一片叶子或一朵花。#0|坏人从树下走过，就只配得到一颗果实——#3.3|当然是没剥过壳的老栗子，我可不是宠物店里那些软乎乎的小家伙。#6.5
character_voice.encontent: Good folks who pass under the tree'll get a leaf or flower on their head. #0|Bad folks, on the other hand, they're gettin' a hard old chestnut on the noggin'—spikes 'n all. #4.2|Oh, I ain't no softy like them pet store animals. I'm a true Floridian—tough as a pair o' old boots.#9.8

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 早上好，伙计！#0|请原谅只有我出席今天的早餐会议，南极特勤先遣分队的成员们还在倒时差。#1
character_voice.encontent: Mornin', pal! #0|Do excuse me for bein' the only one joinin' ya for breakfast. The Antarctic Advance Party's still sufferin' a little jet lag.#1.6

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 我看见你有一片私人湖泊了！#0|我觉得咱们可以在湖边移栽一棵百年树龄的大橡树，那位长翅膀的朋友一定会高兴的，#3|当然，我也是！你觉得怎样？#8.8
character_voice.encontent: I saw your private lake over yonder! #0|If I had my druthers, I'd pull a century oak and plop it right down beside it. Whaddya think? Yer flyin' friend'll looove it—#2.5|Haha, and I sure would, too!#10.4

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 南极起风的夜里，企鹅伙计们会围成一圈把我拱在中间，#0|我把这称为跨物种的伟大友谊！#4.3
character_voice.encontent: Some nights in Antarctica, when the wind was howlin' somethin' fierce, the penguins'd huddle 'round me to keep warm. #0|Beautiful, ain't it? Squirrel and Penguin kind, comin' together as one!#6.5

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 南极起风的夜里，企鹅伙计们会围成一圈把我拱在中间，#0|我把这称为跨物种的伟大友谊！#4.3
character_voice.encontent: Some nights in Antarctica, when the wind was howlin' somethin' fierce, the penguins'd huddle 'round me to keep warm. #0|Beautiful, ain't it? Squirrel and Penguin kind, comin' together as one!#6.5

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 夜里只要在树上落脚，其他松鼠就会把尾巴盖在我身上，#0|没人在乎我是不是属于这棵树，他们像收纳松果一样接纳了嚼嚼松果。#4.6
character_voice.encontent: Don't matter which tree I'm in, if there're squirrels there, we're all snugglin' up come night time. #0|Ain't no one worried 'bout where yer from, or where yer goin'—there I'm just "Buddy," ain't no "Fairchild" about it.#6.3

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 好吧，好吧，尽情摸吧，伙计。#0|享受毛茸茸的快感，就当是嚼嚼松果中士给你的房租。#4
character_voice.encontent: Yeah, yeah, pet the cute little squirrel. #0|But ya better make the most of it, 'cause I'm takin' this as my rent.#2.8

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 中尉替我准备了传呼机，你可以用一串代码来叫醒这个世界，当然也能叫醒嚼嚼松果中士……#0|噢，除了按“收到”键以外，我当然不会其他操作，你在期待一只松鼠做什么？#6.3
character_voice.encontent: The lieutenant gave me this pager. Thing's noisier 'n a mornin' rooster when you get a message. #0|Oh, I won't do nuttin' but press this here red button, o' course. I mean, whaddya expect from a squirrel? A phone call?#4.5

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 这个尾巴毛在亚马逊是绝佳的伪装，#0|但到了南极，简直像一面显眼的旗帜，敬告冰川上所有饿肚子的朋友：#2.3|这里有只不知死活的松鼠！#7.3
character_voice.encontent: This tail o' mine sure came in handy in the Amazon—perfect camouflage! #0|But in Antarctica? Hoo-ee, it was like a billboard screamin' #4.9|"roll on up for a squirrel pub sub"!#10.6

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 你试过在夜里骑摩托穿越金门大桥吗？#0|时速一百二十迈，前爪紧紧搂着司机的脖子，脚蹬着他的背，#2.6|尖叫出声，享受全城的注目！#6.6
character_voice.encontent: Ya know how it feels to ride a motorbike on the Golden Gate Bridge? #0|'Cause I do! 120 miles per hour, clingin' to the rider's neck for dear life, #3.5|and hollerin' out like I was the king o' the city!#8.6

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 保持神秘感，我懂你，伙计，身负绝密任务的特工都这样。向你致敬！#0
character_voice.encontent: Aah, I see what yer doin'. We agents gotta maintain our sense o' mystery. I respect it.#0

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 很少有人愿意坐下来听听松鼠的声音，尽管这只松鼠说的是人话。#0|虽然我看不出来你到底有没有听进去嚼嚼松果的动物保护十箴言，但还是谢啦，伙计！#5.1
character_voice.encontent: Ain't many folks who'd sit down and listen to a squirrel, don't matter how much English he speaks. #0|Anyway, I still ain't sure ya totally understand the "ten tenets of animal protection," but I appreciate ya givin' me yer ear.#7

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 当然，当然，显而易见，这里的神奇动物——和神奇水果都比我更加忧郁博学，#0|“松果某向你致敬”，这显然不是我的风格。#7.2
character_voice.encontent: O' course the animals in here are smarter 'n me—heck, even the fruit's all hoity-toity. #0|"This Buddy salutes you." Nah, ain't my style.#5.8

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 企鹅兄弟们受不了迈阿密的酷暑，那我就该带大伙回极地，回真正的家！#0|所以，你不介意我把空调设置到60华氏度吧？#4.9
character_voice.encontent: There's a reason I took my penguin pals all the way to Antarctica, ya know—the Miami heat had 'em sufferin' somethin' awful. #0|Since they been so kind as to join us in the suitcase, how's about turnin' the AC down a little? Say, to 60°F?#7.5

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 企鹅兄弟们受不了迈阿密的酷暑，那我就该带大伙回极地，回真正的家！#0|所以，你不介意我把空调设置到60华氏度吧？#4.9
character_voice.encontent: There's a reason I took my penguin pals all the way to Antarctica, ya know—the Miami heat had 'em sufferin' somethin' awful. #0|Since they been so kind as to join us in the suitcase, how's about turnin' the AC down a little? Say, to 60°F?#7.5

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 听说嚼嚼松果中士还在被迈阿密警方通缉？#0|作为动物神秘学家，替动物们发声是理所应当的事儿，一次“飞跃动物园”不能算犯罪吧？#3.4|算了，大不了下次回佛罗里达时，我就脱掉装备，回归一只普通松鼠——#9.3|你得替我打掩护，伙计！#14.8
character_voice.encontent: I hear Sergeant Buddy Fairchild's still wanted by the Miami police. #0|Come on, you can't expect an animal not to help out his fellow animals! #5|Well, I guess next time I'm in Florida, I'll have to lose the gear and pretend I'm just a regular ol' squirrel. #9.8|But yer gonna have to cover for me, ya hear?#17

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 又一场极地远征？好极了！#0
character_voice.encontent: Another expedition? Well, let's hop to it!#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 准备好了吗，我的企鹅兄弟们！#0
character_voice.encontent: At the ready, penguin pals!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 闹点大动静！#0
character_voice.encontent: Let's make a scene!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 来吧，伙计们！#0
character_voice.encontent: Come on, pals!#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 所有人，目光向我看齐！#0
character_voice.encontent: Everybody, eyes on me!#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 这可不是什么动物表演！#0
character_voice.encontent: This ain't no animal show!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 尝尝松果吧，真的松果！#0
character_voice.encontent: Get a taste o' this!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 大自然的香味！#0
character_voice.encontent: The smell o' the great outdoors!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我们是最佳搭档！#0
character_voice.encontent: We're the best o' buds!#0

1284011.content: 你好，伙计，我正在做一项有关物种间友谊建设情况的重要调查！
快问快答！你觉得阻拦你和动物朋友们沟通的最大障碍是什么？
无法沟通？噢，你听不懂我们的叫声——这的确是目前我们面临的最大难题！
你觉得我们能拜托苹果朋友，把那位皮克勒斯先生的翻译器量产吗？
要知道，“这只松鼠会说话！”并不是答复所有问题的万能金句！

1284012.content: 我在想，既然现在我在你的麾下，也许应该由你任命，给我一个新头衔。
没错，给我个新头衔吧，伙计！要像松果之于长叶松、酸橙派之于佛罗里达那样响亮！
食物！食物是很重要的！费尔柴尔德松鼠家族靠它过冬，南极特勤先遣分队的企鹅兄弟们靠它补充体力，撑过暴雪和面具怪人的捕杀。
而你，伙计，你要养活这个大树洞里的那么多人，你也该多囤点粮食了！
大副，大副……哦，我在从迈阿密港坐船去南极时听见过这个称呼！
它很响亮，充满信赖感和使命感——而且听起来非常、非常……博学？你从哪得到的灵感？
